title: Fence coordinator failover during live missions
goal: Tie task leases and authoritative mission writes to accepted leadership epochs; partition and reconnect tests reject stale-coordinator writes and preserve the surviving mission state. Deps (vectors): VC-201-022, VC-201-031, VC-201-032. Acceptance is tests named vc_201_035_* in the owning crate; write them with the feature.
